items.Description: A stone furnace that refines copper, tin, and iron ore into bars.
A squat stone kiln built for charcoal making.
Timber boards for the floor of a camp shelter.
A prepared plot for growing crops.
A framed timber doorway that replaces one Windbreak Wall segment.
A squared timber beam that braces supported shelter endpoints.
A reed roof that shields a small camp from rain.
A shared chest for storing camp supplies.
A light timber-and-reed wall that blocks wind around camp.
